name: EmailFunnelAI
tagline: ** EmailFunnelAI ** helps SaaS teams build complete email funnels from ** one prompt **
description: ** EmailFunnelAI ** helps SaaS teams build complete email funnels from ** one prompt **. You describe your audience, offer, and goal, and it creates the email sequence, timing, branching logic, review checks, and follow-up plan in a visual workflow. It is built for lifecycle campaigns like welcome flows, trial conversion, lead magnet follow-up, re-engagement, launch emails, and client campaigns. The product connects with your existing stack, so you can use your own contacts and send through AWS
